game_title: Fallback: Off By One Autopsy – Buried Temple Steps
game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps, steps of a half-buried temple: the caravan guide must hold off desert bandits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Off By One Autopsy: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script.
theme: Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps: steps of a half-buried temple
core_gameplay_loop: In Buried Temple Steps, repeat each round: Diagnose off-by-one failures in loops and indexes in a broken script. Then check autopsy and advance.
player_objective: Protect the sundial from desert bandits in Buried Temple Steps: keep autopsy above zero until the 45-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 6 (applied tier): Off By One Autopsy
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 9, Level 6, Standard. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
